info.title: API.SH: BJ's Wholesale
info.description: The BJ's Wholesale API from API.SH: public BJ's Wholesale data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

The products of a BJ's Wholesale category (department, aisle or shelf) with the same filters, sorts, club prices and paging as search: the category (name, link, description, parents), product count, the products, facets and subcategories with counts. get.description:
BJ's Wholesale clubs near a ZIP code, a city or coordinates, nearest first: club number (use it as `club` in search), name, address, phone, coordinates, distance in miles, time zone, opening hours, department hours (optical, alcohol), features (gas, tire center, bakery, optical, curbside, ...), gas and tire hours and flags such as coming soon, plus `raw`. Filter by one feature.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bjs-clubs

parameters.description: 5-digit ZIP code or City, ST. Or pass lat and lng.

parameters.description: Only clubs with this feature, e.g. Gas, Tire Center, Optical (values in `features`).

get.description:
BJ's Wholesale products by item number (up to 20) or product link: name, link, ids, image, lowest and highest price, online price and availability, every club's price, sale price, stock and pick-up/same-day/EBT eligibility, rating with histogram, recommend ratio and review themes, review count, free shipping, categories, variations and current promotions, plus `raw`. The product page's long description and specifications are not included.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bjs-product

parameters.description: Item number(s), comma separated, or a bjs.com/product/... link (as `item` or `url`).

get.description:
Search BJ's Wholesale Club products with every filter the shop offers: brand, minimum rating, price range, delivery option (shipping, pick up, delivery), clearance, and any other facet the search returns (product type, color, size, ...) through `filters`, in five sort orders. Each product: item number, name, link, product and SKU ids, image, lowest and highest price, the online price and availability, and with `club` that club's price, sale price, in-club stock and pick-up, same-day delivery and EBT eligibility; rating, review count, online and in-club availability, free shipping, price-in-cart flag, categories and variations, plus `raw`. Also returns the facets with counts, matching categories and related searches. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bjs-search

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: Club number (from /bjs/v1/clubs) for that club's prices and stock, e.g. 44 or 0044. Online prices are always included.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand as the shop spells it (comma list = any of), values in facets mfname.

parameters.name: delivery
parameters.description: Delivery option(s): Shipping, Pick Up, Delivery (comma list).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Any other facet as name:value, several values with | and several facets with ; (e.g. product_type:Tool Sets;color:Gray). Names and values as `facets` shows them.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
